summary: Dota entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Dota 2

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.why: Valve distributes Dota 2 through Steam with Windows, macOS, and SteamOS/Linux requirements; Windows remains the most robust capture and compatibility route for the live service.
primary.how_to_play: Install through Steam on Windows, set the desired capture resolution/graphics options, and record the match patch/date because heroes, items, map details, and events change.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service patches, events, hero balance, and map changes mean the captured version should be dated.
